hero.kicker: Abkhazia · sea and mountains in one day
hero.title: A coast where people still know your name
hero.lead: A house on a farm, a car for the coast road, milk from the neighbours and a road into the mountains — arranged in one request, with nobody in between.

home.chooseTitle: Five reasons to write to us

stats.rentals: things to rent by the day
stats.note: We are not an agency. We are a few families on the coast who let out their houses, drive guests into the mountains and sell what they grow.

how.title: No card payment on this site
how.lead: You send a request, the owner replies personally, money changes hands on arrival.

one.title: Send a request
one.body: Pick a house, a car or a route and give your dates. Nothing is charged — no invoice is issued.

two.title: The owner replies
two.body: Usually within a couple of hours. They confirm the dates, answer questions and arrange to meet you.

three.title: Pay on arrival
three.body: Cash, transfer, or however you agree. There is no site commission — the price is the owner's price.

home.marquee: Gagra · Pitsunda · Lake Ritsa · New Athos · Tsandripsh · Mussera · Bzyb · Gudauta · Lykhny · Sukhum
home.ctaLead: Tell us what your trip needs and we'll put it together.

benefits.bestPriceDesc: You book straight with the family, with no agency mark-up
benefits.noFeesDesc: You pay for the stay; deposits come back to you
benefits.freeCancellationDesc: Cancel at no cost up to a few days before arrival

stay.title: Stay
stay.lead: Two ways to stay: rent a whole house on a farm, or a room in a guest yard with breakfast.

village.title: From the village
village.lead: Food from local families — poured into your own container, brought to where you're staying.

rent.title: Rent
rent.lead: Everything a visitor needs by the day: transport, water and beach gear, furniture.

explore.title: Explore
explore.lead: Small groups, early starts, and driver-guides who grew up here.

booking.subtitleStay: The owner will get in touch and confirm your dates. You pay on arrival or by transfer — no card payment on this site.
booking.subtitleRental: We'll confirm availability and arrange hand-over. Pay on collection.
booking.subtitleExcursion: We'll confirm your place in the group and the departure time.
